description: This file is a C source file implementing network query management and callbacks for a WAN manager, including querying interface statuses, handling responses, and managing flags for network modes.

classes.name: nm_query_ll_info_t
classes.description: Structure holding information for network model queries related to a specific logical link, including query identifiers and interface details.

classes.name: intf_isup_queries_t
classes.description: Structure maintaining the status and query handles for IPv4 and IPv6 interface up checks.
